name: vssm-md
description: 苏木的vscode扩展Markdown所见即所得编辑器

vssm-md.preventMacOptionKey.description: Prevent MacOS option key in the markdown editor.

vssm-md.editorTheme.markdownDescription: The theme for the Markdown editor.

vssm-md.codeMirrorTheme.markdownDescription: CodeMirror syntax theme for code blocks in the Markdown editor.

vssm-md.mermaidTheme.markdownDescription: Mermaid diagram theme in the Markdown editor. Auto follows the editor theme.

vssm-md.editMode.markdownDescription: Default edit mode for the Markdown editor.

vssm-md.restoreViewState.markdownDescription: Restore caret focus when opening a Markdown file. Scroll position is always restored.

vssm-md.workspacePathAsImageBasePath.description: Using workspace path as markdown image base path.

vssm-md.pasteImageToWorkspacePath.description: Paste markdown images into the workspace path and insert image links with a leading slash.

vssm-md.pasterImgPath.description: Markdown paste image path, variables: workspaceDir, fileName, now, date (YYYYMMDD), uuid, ext (file extension). Only used when image.insertAction is "legacy".

enumDescriptions: Classic behavior: build path from vssm-md.pasterImgPath template.
No special action: local images are referenced as-is, not copied.
Copy image to the current folder (./).
Copy image to the ./${filename}.assets folder next to the document.
Copy image to the ./${filename}.assets folder (per-document assets folder).
Upload image to a PicGo-compatible HTTP server (vssm-md.image.uploadServer).
vssm-md.image.insertAction.markdownDescription: Where to put images when pasting or inserting into the Markdown editor (Typora-style rules). Relative folders are resolved against the document folder.

vssm-md.image.customPath.markdownDescription: Target folder for the "custom" insert action. A relative path starting with `./` or `../` (resolved against the document folder) or an absolute path. `${filename}` is the current document name; legacy variables ${workspaceDir}, ${fileName}, ${now}, ${date}, ${uuid}, ${ext} are also supported.

vssm-md.image.applyToLocal.description: Apply the insert action rules to local images (clipboard data, picked or dropped image files).

vssm-md.image.applyToWeb.description: Apply the insert action rules to network images: pasting an image URL downloads it into the target folder instead of keeping the URL.

vssm-md.image.allowYamlUpload.description: Allow the `typora-copy-images-to: upload` YAML front matter to trigger image uploading.

vssm-md.image.preferRelativePath.description: Use a relative path in the generated image reference when the image is inside the document folder.

vssm-md.image.prefixDotSlash.description: Prefix relative image references with ./ (except ../ ones).

vssm-md.image.escapeUrl.description: Percent-encode image URLs (spaces, non-ASCII, brackets) when inserting the reference.

vssm-md.image.uploadServer.description: PicGo-compatible upload endpoint (POST {list:[path]} -> {result:[url]}) used by the "upload" insert action.

vssm-md.chromiumPath.description: Set the chromium browser location for exporting markdown pdf.

vssm-md.puppeteerArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to Puppeteer/Chromium when exporting PDF. Example: ["--no-sandbox", "--disable-setuid-sandbox"] for Linux servers running as root.

vssm-md.enableTelemetry.markdownDescription: Enable anonymous usage data collection to help improve Office Viewer. This respects VS Code global telemetry settings (`#telemetry.telemetryLevel#`).
